resources.string: A tiny pet that lives on your Glyph Matrix. Long-press to pick an action, then wait.
Your Dotchi on the home screen
START OVER WITH A NEW EGG
Your current pet will be replaced by a new egg.

Your Dotchi can come on walks with you, using your phone\'s step counter, and react to the weather where you are, using your approximate location. Nothing leaves your phone except a rough location sent to a free weather service. You can change this later in your phone\'s settings.
